children: Profusa entered into a financing agreement, issuing a senior secured convertible promissory note to Ascent Partners Fund for $329,670.33 in principal, yielding $300,000 in proceeds due to original issue discount. The note bears 7% interest, matures on Sep 1, 2027 (or earlier per Option Closing Date), and is convertible at $4.28 per share, with a $1.07 floor subject to adjustment. Amortization begins Jan 1, 2027, with optional stock payments if conditions are met, and 33% of net proceeds from any subsequent offering must prepay the note. The obligations are secured by substantially all company assets, with default interest at 18%.

: Raise working capital and enhance liquidity
